scope: 64 new analytic paired conditions; supplied point-set grouping, no RGB/DA3/physical-identity claim. Both voxel-center and equal-voxel raw-point diagnostic representations. No automatic axis or acceptance rule.
interpretation_limits: Parameters estimated on alternate axial slices; global PCA frame uses all input, so this is conditional cross-section prediction, not fully held-out reconstruction.
Model fit rankings are not classifications, likelihood ratios or calibrated confidence. Nonconverged/boundary fits remain visible.
An empty point-space region is unobserved, not measured free space. No tube/background identity is inferred.
Noise, crop and phase variants are paired conditions, not independent objects. Old 16 positives never choose thresholds.
Raw points are weighted inversely by occupied-cell population after exact deduplication. Both representations use the same center-based PCA frame.
